remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo offering modern finishes, spacious living, and beautiful views of the Long Island Sound from the 11th floor. Step inside to find new flooring and fresh paint throughout, a bright and generously sized living room, and a private balcony perfect for enjoying the views. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and plenty of cabinet space, while the modern bathroom has been tastefully renovated. Both bedrooms are well-sized with ample storage throughout the home. Located in a well-maintained complex offering security and a community pool, all in a great location close to shopping, dining, transportation, and everyday conveniences. Move-in ready and a great place to call home!
